layman_headline: Holding steady — the market is cooling off and no new opportunities justify jumping in right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is pulling back slightly, with most altcoins losing value over the past 24 hours. Our two current positions — Solana and Uniswap — are both in profit, with UNI up nearly 5% and approaching its exit target. The swing candidates on our watchlist are either overbought (PUMP with RSI 84), lack technical data to form a conviction, or are meme coins in steep decline without clear bottoms. Bitcoin dominance remains high at nearly 60%, which means money is flowing into Bitcoin rather than altcoins, making new alt entries riskier.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. UNI is close to its profit target of $5.65 — consider taking profits if it gets there in the next few days. Keep SOL's stop-loss at $92 and watch for any momentum shift. Don't chase any of the beaten-down coins right now without clearer signals.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is unusually weak this cycle. PUMP has an RSI of 84 — severely overbought — despite being down 16% on the week, suggesting extreme volatility and unreliable technicals. MON, PEPE, and TRUMP lack RSI/MACD data and are in secular downtrends (down 45-97% from ATH) without clear support levels. FDUSD, USDG, and XAUT are stablecoins/gold-backed with no swing opportunity. BTC dominance at 59.7% continues to suppress alt performance broadly. Fear & Greed dropping from 69 to 62 signals worsening sentiment that could accelerate alt selling. The prudent move is to manage existing positions toward their targets rather than force a new entry in a hostile alt environment.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed index trending downward — could accelerate into fear territory and drag alts further
BTC dominance at 59.7% is compressing alt valuations; any further BTC strength could hurt SOL and UNI
UNI's +12.9% weekly move may be overextended; a broader market pullback could erase gains before exit target is hit
watch_list: UNI approaching $5.65 exit target — monitor for profit-taking opportunity within 48 hours
Fear & Greed index direction — if it drops below 55, consider tightening stop-losses on both positions
Michael Saylor's potential BTC purchase announcement — could spike BTC dominance further and pressure alts
market_context: The crypto market is in a mild pullback with BTC flat on the week but alts bleeding. BTC dominance at 59.7% and a deteriorating Fear & Greed index (62, down from 69) suggest caution for altcoin entries.
context_banner: Alt market under pressure from rising BTC dominance — protect existing gains and wait for clearer setups.

PUMP's RSI at 84 is severely overbought, ruling it out despite its pullback; no other candidates have RSI data available.
No volume breakout signals detected among swing candidates — volume data is largely missing, reducing conviction for new entries.
